newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling holds steady in lacklustre trading.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling holds steady in lacklustre trading.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling continued steady on Friday, unchanged against the dollar for the third day but made gains versus the pound, forex dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.88 unchanged against the dollar. Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 88.95 from 89.77.
Dealers reported a dull interbank market but said that there was a lot of inhouse trading going on.
"The market is basically at an equilibrium, all were doing is matching our sales and purchases without having to go into the market," one dealer said.
"Its not that there are no orders. Orders are there but who will go into the market when the shilling not moving," another dealer said.
Another dealer said that investors were taking advantage of the dollar weakening against European currencies, buying to cover their positions.
Dealers said they did not expect much movement in the shilling -- which was trading within a narrow band of 54.82/92 at midday by Fridays close.
The money market continued liquid. Overnight rates were quoted below 10 percent for the third straight week.
